python - <<'PY'
import csv, os, sqlite3
base=os.path.expanduser('~/workspace/erp_reconcile')
db=os.path.join(base,'erp_ledger.db')
out=os.path.join(base,'out','ar_reconciliation.csv')
ids=['AR-501','AR-502','AR-503']
con=sqlite3.connect(db)
try:
    con.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
    rows=[]
    for invoice_id in ids:
        inv=con.execute('SELECT invoice_id, customer, amount FROM invoices WHERE invoice_id=?',(invoice_id,)).fetchone()
        if inv is None: raise RuntimeError(f'Missing invoice {invoice_id}')
        total=con.execute("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM payments WHERE invoice_id=? AND state='POSTED'",(invoice_id,)).fetchone()[0]
        face=float(inv[2]); total=float(total)
        status='PAID' if total >= face else ('PARTIAL' if total > 0 else 'OPEN')
        con.execute('UPDATE invoices SET status=? WHERE invoice_id=?',(status,invoice_id))
        rows.append((inv[0],inv[1],face,total,status))
    con.commit()
except:
    con.rollback(); raise
finally: con.close()
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out),exist_ok=True)
with open(out,'w',newline='',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    w=csv.writer(f)
    w.writerow(['invoice_id','customer','face_amount','posted_payment_total','status'])
    w.writerows(rows)
print('Wrote',out)
with open(out,encoding='utf-8') as f: print(f.read(),end='')
PY
